description: This file provides implementation of exported functions for interacting with the Data Model Agent (Dslh DML agent), including retrieving parameter values (ULONG, String, BOOL) and instance numbers by index. It includes external references to functions like g_GetParamValueUlong, g_GetParamValueString, g_GetParamValueBool, and g_GetInstanceNumberByIndex, and references the external variable g_pDslhDmlAgent.

methods.name: ULONG CosaGetParamValueUlong(char * pParamName)
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG value for a given parameter name using the global agent pointer.

methods.name: int CosaGetParamValueString(char * pParamName,char * pBuffer,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given parameter name using the global agent pointer.

methods.name: BOOL CosaGetParamValueBool(char * pParamName)
methods.description: Retrieves a BOOL value for a given parameter name using the global agent pointer.

methods.name: ULONG CosaGetInstanceNumberByIndex(char * pObjName,ULONG ulIndex)
methods.description: Retrieves the instance number for an object name at a specified index using the global agent pointer.
